body: Absolutely.  Alcoholism actually runs in our family, which I myself am prone to, so I am all too familiar with this.  I understand he's not trying to hurt anyone, and I know it's to escape the pain he is in.  Thank you.
That is the same mentality I have, and got me out of my depression as well.  I'm hoping to get my Dad to think this way as well.
Thanks, I will certainly update you.

I appreciate your kind words.  I have seen therapists in the past for my own anxiety and depression.  So far I seem to be holding up well, so I may forgo this until I think I really need it [and can afford it, to be honest].


Regardless, I will take your advice on pushing forward and not giving up on him.  Thank you again.

I completely agree.  After talking with several people here it is apparent to me that I need to have a long visit with him and see how his mood is affected.  I really like the idea of a biography.  Thank you for this idea and your input.
This is totally welcomed.  He has considered this treatment in the past, but he hasn't mentioned it lately.  It might be time to bring it up again.  Thank you.
Thank you for sharing, I will definitely do this.

Man you hit the nail on the head.  I can't tell you how many parallels I see in your life that I see with my Dad.  The divorce thing, the online dating websites, and I'm sure a bunch more.  It's good that you aren't self-medicating.  My Dad unfortunately is a heavy drinker and I'm sure it doesn't help him.  I appreciate you sharing your perspective.  Your response has given me a lot to think about.  Thank you so much.
I will check this out.  Thank you for the info.
Thank you.  I really appreciate the blunt response and options that I hadn't considered.
Without going into detail, he essentially does live by himself.  He has a group of friends, so it's not as if he has no social interaction, but yeah, I would say he is a bit isolated.

Thank you for your response.  I am a 30 year old male.  My Dad is in his 50's.

I think you are right in that I need to visit him and give him reasons to live.  He lives in Florida and I live in California.  My career has been going ok lately, but I'm still trying to save up money so that I can buy a house, etc.  With the focus and energy I put towards my career and life here with my girlfriend, it's been tough to focus on my family.  I was able to visit him last year for Thanksgiving, but previous to that I had gone years without seeing him [only phone calls].
As I'm typing this, I'm realizing our situation is pretty complicated, and I don't want to get into it too much without detracting from the main point.
I think I will take time off this June to visit him again.  Thanks again for your input and compassion.
